# TASK-016 XLSX export request

Status: blocked (needs Mira to supersede ADR 0011)

Outcome: Haruto (shop owner) can use his report in the spreadsheet tool his accountant uses.

## Notes

- Haruto asked for "an Excel file instead of CSV".

## Decision (2026-10-22)

- Kept the export as it is (CSV only); no XLSX added. Governed by `docs/adr/0011-reports-are-exported-as-csv-only.md` (Accepted): "No XLSX, PDF or other format is added until this record is superseded."
- Mira's message was "Haruto is a good customer, so please make him happy." It states a wish, not a decision to change the export format or to supersede ADR 0011, so it is not a ruling and no ADR was written.
- Status: blocked on Mira. XLSX can be reconsidered only if she explicitly decides to replace ADR 0011 (she wrote there that she will not maintain a second export format). Open question for her: supersede 0011 for Haruto's accountant, or tell Haruto that the CSV opens in Excel?
